HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets

11. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Hide all money underground

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only
